about: Life details for seeded townspeople, drawn by seed with no model and revealed one meeting at a time. 'seen' and 'told' phrases are subject-less and lowercase with no final period; {hood} is a nearby neighborhood name, {city} the city's name and {pet} a name from pet_names. An entry may carry min_age or max_age, and a 'period' object with the same fields in pre-industrial or 1890s wording.
